builds.title: Nezumi trail scout, Warrior 1
traits: Leather armor. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 12. Base attack bonus +1. Face 5 by 5 ft., reach 5 ft. unless using the longspear.
Fortitude +3, Reflex +1, Will +0. Add +2 on saves against poison and disease.
Alertness is the chosen feat. Scent is an optional species feat and is not part of this build.
Cannot gain Shadowlands Taint from exposure. Spells and special attacks associated with the Taint still apply.
actions: Longspear. Melee +2, 10-ft. reach only. Hit 1d8+1 piercing, critical ×3.
Claw or bite. Melee +2, 5-ft. reach. Hit 1d4+1 normal damage. One such unarmed attack per round.
Javelin. Ranged +2, 30-ft. range increment. Hit 1d6+1 piercing, critical ×2.
builds.tactics: Warns from cover first. Uses the spear to hold a narrow passage or the javelin to cover a retreat. Falls back if the party agrees to verify the route together.

builds.title: Vanara canopy guide, Expert 1
traits: Leather armor. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 12. Base attack bonus +0. Face 5 by 5 ft., reach 5 ft.
Fortitude +1, Reflex +1, Will +2. Alertness is the chosen feat.
Climb uses Dexterity and can take 10 under pressure for a result of 23. Accelerated climb 30 ft. with one Climb check per round at +8 after the −5 penalty.
actions: Club. Melee −1, 5-ft. reach. Hit 1d6−1 bludgeoning, minimum 1, critical ×2.
Light crossbow. Ranged +1, 80-ft. range increment. Hit 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. Reload as a move-equivalent action.
builds.tactics: Stays near a climbable route, points out safe handholds, and keeps people moving. Uses a loaded crossbow from cover only if the group is forced to defend itself.

concepts.name: Tesk Reedmark
concepts.motive: Keep the refuge supplied after travelers stop trusting the road markers.
concepts.hook: Tesk saw who moved the flood markers and will take the party to the washed-out trail if someone stays to warn incoming travelers.

concepts.name: Nemi
concepts.motive: Get a repair crew across the ravine before another support gives way.
concepts.hook: Nemi can lead the party up an old canopy route if they carry a coil of rope and check the upper anchor.
